task_fulfillment.rationale: The workbook provides comprehensive weekly schedules, correct demand transcription and useful comparisons, but needs material correction before use. It relies on unconfirmed pull-forward, incorrectly claims the same dates remain valid without it, permits four-day weeks above 120 hours, and omits the first feasible five-day step-down under its own model. Positive capacity balances are also treated as completed-work buffers indefinitely, reaching beyond all supplied demand. The designated email summary is listed but unavailable for inspection. Formula recalculation and rendering are separate, unvalidated endpoints.
